name: Quote generation - MDF 18mm
description: Customer requests a quote for a different product (MDF 18mm). AI should use generate_quote, return total and PDF link.

messages.text: Hi, my name is Test Customer. I'd like a quote for 12 sheets of MDF 18mm please

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a quote total with R prefix
Quote should be generated (quote_total populated or PDF URL in reply)
Quote generation may take up to 30 seconds

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply
No internal optimizer variable names in reply

notes: Tests quote generation for a different product type (MDF 18mm) rather than melamine chipboard.
